issues: Only the 2025-26 Program of Studies is linked (PDF printed from Google Docs, created 2025-08-21); no 2026-27 edition found although the 2026-27 year is underway. The 2026-27 Student Handbook is posted and holds the graduation requirements (26 credits; 4 Eng, 4 Sci, 4 Math, 3 SS, 2 PE, 1 Art, 0.5 Health, 7.5 electives). WARNING: the old school domain lelandandgray.org / www.lelandandgray.org (still cited inside the catalog: 'Additional information ... www.lelandandgray.org') now redirects to an unrelated gambling/spam site - do not use it. Old Google Sites (sites.google.com/windhamcentral.org/leland-gray) now require sign-in. Catalog covers grades 9-12 departments plus Flexible Pathways, Special Ed, CTE (Windham Regional Career Center); electives/AP courses rotate, not all run every year.
